push notification.note: Existing server/webapp bg.json consistently uses 'изскачащи известия' for push notifications. Modern alternative 'push известие' exists, but keep the established rendering.

bottom sheet.note: No established bg term; 'долен панел' describes the sliding bottom panel naturally.

swipe.note: Verb prose: 'плъзнете' (formal plural, matching repo register).

long-press.note: Instructional prose: 'натиснете и задръжте' (standard Android Bulgarian).

toast.note: Avoid 'изскачащо съобщение' — 'изскачащи известия' is already the established rendering for push notifications.

clipboard.note: Standard Bulgarian Windows/Android term. 'копирано в клипборда'.

jailbroken.note: Adjective phrase: 'устройство с джейлбрейк'; rooted (Android) = 'с root достъп'.

app logs.note: Logs = 'Дневници' established in webapp bg.json (Системна конзола > Дневници).

deep link.note: Link = 'връзка' established. 'дълбока връзка' is the common Bulgarian rendering in Android developer material.

server connection.note: Add a server = 'Добавяне на сървър'; switch server = 'Смяна на сървъра'.
